mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher input costs.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM decrease > 2% and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both increase and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ decrease > 1% and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.
